description: This script configures mesh network interfaces, bridges, and backhaul setup for different device models, including handling extender mode, VLANs, and specific device configurations.

methods.name: mesh_bridges
methods.description: Adds WiFi interfaces to specified bridge and configures IP addresses and iptables settings.

methods.name: mesh_bhaul
methods.description: Creates a backhaul bridge and configures IP and iptables.

methods.name: is_vlan
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is a VLAN.

methods.name: vlan_root
methods.description: Extracts the root interface name from a VLAN interface name.

methods.name: bridge_interfaces
methods.description: Lists interfaces associated with a bridge.

methods.name: bridge_set_mtu
methods.description: Sets the MTU for a bridge and its member interfaces.

methods.name: mesh_bridge_setup
methods.description: Initializes mesh bridge setup including creating bridges and adding interfaces.

methods.name: mesh_bridge_ip
methods.description: Configures IP address for a mesh bridge.
